scope_note.zh: 核对中国国内 MiniMax 官方托管语言 API 的当前模型列表、调用指南、计费及下线通知，覆盖其列出的 M 系列对话、推理、编程与多模态理解型号，并保留 FAQ 明确列出的已下线语言型号；不宣称穷尽此前已从目录移除的 abab/Text-01 等历史档案，也不把本地开源权重当作托管 API 可用证据。按量 API、M Plan 与 Token Plan 的密钥、计费及路由必须分开看；仅订阅可用的预览型号已逐项注明，不推断国际站账户或其他区域权限。排除转售、图像/视频/音乐生成、独立语音、向量、重排及纯 OCR。本表无固定价格、参数上限或新增调用实测，模型状态以生命周期通知而非价目残留为依据。
scope_note.en: Checked against mainland-China MiniMax hosted-language API catalogs, calling guides, billing pages and retirement notices. Covers the listed M-series conversational, reasoning, coding and multimodal-understanding models, plus language models explicitly marked retired in the FAQ. This is not an exhaustive archive of earlier abab/Text-01 models removed from those catalogs; local open weights are not evidence of hosted API availability. Pay-as-you-go API, M Plan and Token Plan keys, billing and routing must be distinguished. Subscription-only preview access is noted per model; international-account or other-region permissions are not inferred. Excludes resold models, image/video/music generation, standalone speech, embeddings, reranking and pure OCR. No fixed prices, request limits or new execution tests are included. Lifecycle notices take precedence over stale entries in price tables.

notes.zh: 目前仅通过 M Plan 和 MiniMax Code 提供，不是普通按量 API 可用型号；M Plan 订阅 Key 与普通按量 API Key 不通用。Token Plan 老用户安排另见订阅公告；其他型号名称重路由到此模型也不代表执行了原型号。
notes.en: Currently provided only through M Plan and MiniMax Code, not as a regular pay-as-you-go API model. M Plan subscription keys and regular pay-as-you-go keys are not interchangeable. Existing Token Plan arrangements are documented separately; another model name being rerouted here does not mean that the original model ran.

notes.zh: 官方可用语言模型及按量计费页均列出此准确 ID；图片和视频输入由 Chat Completions API 明确支持，不从其他模态生成产品推断。
notes.en: This exact ID is listed in the available language models and pay-as-you-go pricing. Image and video input are explicitly supported by the Chat Completions API, not inferred from separate media-generation products.

notes.zh: 官方仍列为可用语言模型；按量付费 API：2026-10-19 起停止向新用户开放，存量用户可继续调用至 2026-11-18 正式下线，核对日尚未下线。M Plan/Token Plan：2026-10-19 起该名称的请求统一路由至 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview，名称仅保留为兼容入口；不能把订阅重路由提前算作按量 API 下线。
notes.en: Still listed as an available language model. Pay-as-you-go API: closed to new users from 2026-10-19, while existing users may continue until retirement on 2026-11-18; it is not retired on the check date. M Plan/Token Plan: requests using this name are to be routed to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview from 2026-10-19, retaining the name only as a compatibility entry. Subscription rerouting is not an earlier pay-as-you-go API retirement.
